subcategory: ID.IM-P1: Systems, products, and services that process data are inventoried
implementation: Maintain an inventory of systems, products, and services that process data.

subcategory: ID.IM-P2: Owners or operators of systems, products, and services are identified
implementation: Assign accountable owners for systems, products, and services that process data.

subcategory: ID.IM-P3: Categories of individuals whose data is processed are inventoried
implementation: Identify and document the categories of individuals represented in organizational data.

subcategory: ID.RA-P1: Contextual factors related to the processing of data are identified
implementation: Document legal, business, technical, and organizational context for data processing.

subcategory: ID.RA-P2: Data processing is evaluated to identify problematic data actions
implementation: Review processing activities for privacy risks and unintended consequences.

subcategory: ID.RA-P3: Privacy risks are identified and documented
implementation: Maintain a privacy risk register with likelihood, impact, owners, and treatment plans.

subcategory: PR.DS-P1: Data-at-rest is protected
implementation: Apply access controls, encryption, retention, and disposal controls to stored data.

subcategory: PR.DS-P2: Data-in-transit is protected
implementation: Protect data in transit using approved network security and cryptographic controls.

subcategory: PR.DS-P3: Data processing policies are implemented
implementation: Implement documented policies for collection, use, sharing, retention, and deletion.

subcategory: CT.PO-P1: Data processing policies and practices are communicated
implementation: Publish clear privacy notices and communicate material changes to affected individuals.

subcategory: CT.DM-P1: Data processing is managed according to policies
implementation: Monitor processing activities against approved privacy policies and purposes.

subcategory: CT.DM-P2: Individuals are provided with data processing information
implementation: Provide understandable information about purposes, data categories, and sharing.

subcategory: CT.DS-P1: Data subjects are provided with mechanisms to access data
implementation: Provide a documented process for data access requests and identity verification.

subcategory: CT.DS-P2: Data subjects are provided with mechanisms to rectify data
implementation: Provide a documented process to correct inaccurate personal data.

subcategory: CT.DS-P3: Data subjects are provided with mechanisms to request deletion
implementation: Provide a documented process to request deletion where legally applicable.

subcategory: GV.PO-P1: Organizational privacy policies are established
implementation: Establish, approve, communicate, and periodically review privacy policies.

subcategory: GV.PO-P2: Privacy roles and responsibilities are coordinated
implementation: Define privacy responsibilities, authorities, escalation paths, and accountability.

subcategory: GV.RM-P1: Privacy risk objectives are established
implementation: Set privacy risk objectives aligned with organizational mission and stakeholder expectations.

subcategory: GV.RM-P2: Privacy risk tolerance is established
implementation: Define and communicate acceptable levels of privacy risk and residual risk.

subcategory: GV.SC-P1: Privacy requirements for suppliers and partners are established
implementation: Include privacy requirements, due diligence, monitoring, and incident obligations in third-party agreements.
